name: CC-OCR
intro: CC-OCR基准旨在全面评估大型多模态模型在光学字符识别（OCR）方面的能力。它涵盖了多场景文本阅读、多语言文本阅读、文档解析和关键信息提取四个核心OCR任务。该基准包含39个子集，共7,058张完全标注的图像，其中41%来源于真实应用场景并首次发布。CC-OCR通过多样化的场景、任务和挑战，旨在推动LMM在OCR中心任务上的持续进步。
org: Alibaba Group, South China University of Technology
task_type: 图像问答, 文本识别, 信息抽取
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.02210: CC-OCR constructs a comprehensive OCR benchmark from existing benchmarks with qualified annotations, re-annotated datasets, and newly collected images, prioritizing diversity, practicality, and challenge. It organizes 7,058 fully annotated images into four OCR-centric tracks and 39 subsets: multi-scene text reading, multilingual text reading, document parsing, and key information extraction; the data include natural scenes, documents, web images, real-shot multilingual documents, tables, formulas, and constrained/open-category KIE. New annotations are produced through model-based pre-annotation, cross-validation by different models, and manual correction; text uses transcriptions and word-level grounding, documents use LaTeX, tables use HTML, formulas use LaTeX or SMILES, and extraction uses JSON. Evaluation uses task-specific metrics including Eval-Trans/Eval-Pos, normalized edit distance, TEDS, field-level F1, grounding precision/recall, and repetition ratio across nine LMMs.
task_type_en: Visual Question Answering, Text Recognition, Information Extraction
intro_en: The CC-OCR benchmark aims to comprehensively evaluate large multimodal models' capabilities in optical character recognition (OCR). It covers four core OCR tasks: multi-scene text reading, multilingual text reading, document parsing, and key information extraction. The benchmark includes 39 subsets with a total of 7,058 fully annotated images, 41% of which come from real-world applications and are newly released. By offering diverse scenarios, tasks, and challenges, CC-OCR seeks to drive continuous progress of LMMs in core OCR tasks.
